newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon debt up 8.8 pct Jan-April.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon debt up 8.8 pct Jan-April.

text.p: Lebanon's total domestic and foreign debt rose $272 million in April to $11,601 million, the finance ministry said on Thursday.
It brought to $939 million the increase in total debt in the first four months of the year -- a rise of 8.8 percent from $10,662 million at the start of January.
Foreign debt rose $2 million in April to $1,890 million for a year-to-date increase of $32 million or two percent since the start of January when it stood at $1,852 million.

Net domestic debt rose $270 million in April to $9,711 million, bringing the year-to-date increase to $901 million -- a rise of 10.2 percent since the start of January when it stood at $8,810 million.
